name: runtime-asset-tracker
description: Track Docker assets, Git worktrees, residual directories, and host artifacts with portable labels and an append-only JSONL ledger.

interface.shortDescription: Label and trace Docker assets across projects.
interface.longDescription: A cross-project runtime asset console with an MCP Apps dashboard, project-bound EC2 identity metadata, disk-capacity KPIs, credential-profile references, portable Docker labels, append-only lifecycle ledger, retained/expiring/reclaimable capacity classification, read-only deep lineage analysis, exact image/volume/cache analysis, narrowly scoped safe cleanup for connected EC2 and GitHub sources, and Linux/Windows observers. It never stores private keys or cloud secrets and does not introduce release approval gates.
capabilities: Image reference and volume mount analysis
Project-bound EC2 identity and disk capacity
SSH and AWS credential profile references
Current and rollback image protection bindings
Real-byte Git worktree and residual inventory
defaultPrompt: Open the runtime asset dashboard and show what is reclaimable.
Preview safe Docker cleanup without deleting anything.
Show recent runtime asset events across projects.
